newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz says no plans to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Allianz says no plans to raise capital.

text.p: Europe's leading insurance group Allianz AG Holding said on Monday that it had no current plans to raise its capital.
"We have no need for capital at the moment and therefore no current plans for a capital increase, chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle told the German group's annual shareholder meeting.
Schulte-Noelle added that Allianz would probably report its 1997 earnings according to International Accounting Standards (IAS).
The accounts would be calculated in Euros as soon as the currency was introduced, with the cost of the switch for its German units alone estimated at around 100 million marks.
